name: CleanSlice
description: Architecture documentation and patterns for building NestJS and Nuxt full-stack applications.

tools.name: get-started
tools.description: ⚠️ CRITICAL: request this tool first before creating any code! Returns essential slice creation rules. READ THIS FIRST before creating any slices! Contains the MOST IMPORTANT naming rule: ALWAYS use SINGULAR names (user/ not users/).

tools.name: list-categories
tools.description: List all available documentation categories. Use this to discover what categories are available before searching.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for relevant documentation. Use `list-categories` first to see available categories. Filter by query text, framework, phase, feature, category, or tags. Returns documents sorted by relevance.

query.description: Search query text (searches in document names, descriptions, and keywords)

sliceName.description: Name of the slice to find documentation for

workingOn.description: Which application you are currently working on

tags.description: Array of tags to filter by

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

tools.name: read-doc
tools.description: Read the full content of a specific document by path. Use this after `search` to get the complete document when snippets are not enough.
